prompts.prompt: Without looking at your notes, explain Relationship between intelligence and creativity. What is the central idea?
prompts.answer: The uploaded sources treat intelligence and creativity as related but distinguishable constructs. Baron & Misra's confluence approach describes creativity as emerging from the convergence of intellectual abilities, thinking styles, personality traits, supportive environments, intrinsic motivation and knowledge. Their cited evidence found intellectual ability, thinking style and personality related to creativity, while creativity across domains was only moderately related.
